title: Feature/5114 add parallel commit config
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Adds support for parallel commits in git graphs.

Resolves #5114 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

The logic consists on searching for the closest parent commit of the current commit being positioned and placing it right after said parent, instead of the default that places after the latest commit.

`parallelCommits: false`
![image](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/assets/31048764/2716fae7-36f8-4457-aa3f-20e4ce9849c5)

`parallelCommits: true`
![image](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/assets/31048764/decdb701-4358-4281-9703-ebec2d0871f7)

author: mathbraga

comments.author: nirname
comments.body:
There is already `gitGraphConfig` defined
```suggestion
  const isParallelCommits = gitGraphConfig.parallelCommits;
```

comments.author: nirname
comments.body:
It seems there is only one argument in `findClosesParent` function, so the second is extra
```suggestion
      const closestParent = findClosestParent(commit.parents);
```

comments.author: nirname
comments.body: There is no check for the case when `closesParent` is blank string. I am not sure, maybe there is always an empty element in `commitPos`, but it seems strange a little bit. Initial commit should not have a parent, for instance, if I am not mistaken

comments.author: mathbraga
comments.body:
`closestParent` will never be blank here I believe. The `commit.parents.length` in the `if` condition guarantees that the commit has atleast 1 parent, so the `findClosestParent` inside always returns a parent. Initial commit for example won't satisfy this `if` condition since its `commit.parents.length` will be 0.

I could pass the `closestParent` definition to outside the `if`, just above it, and then change the `if` condition to something like this:
```javascript
if (isParallelCommits && closestParent) {...}
```

But tell me if you still wish to change this.

comments.author: nirname
comments.body: Maybe it is better to return undefined when parent is missing

comments.author: mathbraga
comments.body: The way I used `findClosestParent` in the code guarantees the function returns a parent as I mentioned above. But I do agree to return `undefined` for correctness, and the function could be used in other contexts aswell.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: If we move the magic numbers 40 and 10 to constants (and replace other usages), that would be nice.

comments.author: mathbraga
comments.body: Noticed the `pos + 10` was very repetitive throughout the code so I also made that into a const. Some of the 10 values seemed to have a different context so I left them untouched.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Shouldn't posWithOffset be set after the if block, as pos is updated inside it?

comments.author: mathbraga
comments.body: Yes it should, it even breaks the tests I added, not sure how I missed this. Good catch.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Oh, and please swap the blocks of this `if` to avoid the negation.
